comment: Traceability is discussed mainly before acting on a model output. The guidance does not cover post-deployment auditability, incident investigation, correction, model withdrawal, or notification of affected users.

anchor.note: p.106 l.Lines 75-83 read as the printed page; section 5.2 agrees

public.text: Traceability is discussed mainly before acting on a model output. The guidance does not cover post-deployment auditability, incident investigation, correction, model withdrawal, or notification of affected users.
public.suggestedRevision: Add requirements for post-market or post-deployment monitoring, incident reporting, corrective action, rollback, model suspension, user notification, and retention of evidence needed for investigation.
